context_for_next_testing_agent: Recipe catalog bug fix verified. The page at /recipes-catalog now loads correctly with all 37 recipes. Category filters (Energie & Müdigkeit, etc.) work. Time filters (Schnell, Mittel, Aufwaendig) work. Search by text works. Empty state shows when no results. Reset filters button works. The bug was: 3 references to undefined 'recipes' variable instead of 'filteredRecipes', plus race condition with 2 useEffects. Both issues have been resolved.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: The component referenced an undefined variable 'recipes' in 3 places in the JSX instead of 'filteredRecipes'. Additionally, there were 2 separate useEffects causing a race condition during data fetch. Fix: All 'recipes' references replaced with 'filteredRecipes', and data fetching consolidated into a single useEffect.
